about.p1: Every day, companies generate a considerable amount of information. Yet turning that data into strategic decisions remains a challenge.
about.p2: At Athenable, we design artificial intelligence that automates analysis, reveals opportunities, and simplifies complexity. Our goal is to free decision-makers from low-value tasks so they can focus on what really makes a difference: understanding, deciding, and innovating.
about.p3: We believe technology only has value when it strengthens human intelligence.

chat.title: Anna
facts: The human brain makes about 35,000 decisions a day — most of them without us even noticing.
"Choice paralysis" grows with the number of options: beyond 7, decision quality drops.
The best strategic decisions usually combine objective data with expert intuition — not one without the other.
Sleeping on a decision genuinely improves judgment: the brain keeps sorting information while you sleep.
Confirmation bias pushes us to only notice information that confirms what we already believe — the worst enemy of a good decision.
Deciding fast isn't always worse: under uncertainty, a quick reversible decision often beats a slow perfect one.
Leaders who document their decisions tend to make better decisions in the future — the mirror effect of hindsight.
